title: Internal SSH fails when SSPI Auth enabled

## Description

Any SSH interaction with the internal SSH server running leads to the following error printed to the ssh client:
```
Gitea: Internal Server Error
invalid character '<' looking for beginning of value
fatal: Could not read from remote repository

Please make sue you have the correct access rights and the repository exists
```
Clone/Push/Pull all work over http without issue.

Server setup: Authentication sources are 
 1. SPNEGO with SSPI enabled as an authentication source
 2. LDAP BIND (to same AD for access when not using windows clients)

If I disable the SSPI authentication source then SSH works as expected. re-enabling SSPI stops the SSH again.
